  UNION ALL SELECT m.home_team_api_id, m.home_player_9 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.home_team_api_id, m.home_player_10 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.home_team_api_id, m.home_player_11 FROM "Match" m
), away_players AS (
  SELECT m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id, m.away_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_2 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_3 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_4 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_5 FROM "Match" m

  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_8 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_9 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_10 FROM "Match" m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_11 FROM "Match" m
), all_players AS (
  SELECT * FROM home_players
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM away_players
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, t.team_long_name
FROM all_players ap
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = ap.player_api_id
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ap.team_api_id
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON ta.team_api_id = ap.team_api_id
WHERE ta.date > '2015-01-01';
